newsitem.title: USA: Poppe Tyson cuts IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Poppe Tyson cuts IPO price range.

text.p: Poppe Tyson Inc has dropped the price for shares to be offered in its initial public offering.
New York-based Poppe Tyson plans to offer three million shares in a range of $9 to $11 each, according to a regulatory documents. It had previously filed for a range of $10 to $12.

The company, part of Bozell, Jacobs, Kenyon & Eckhardt Inc, is an advertising and marketing agency that specializes in the Internet and CD-ROMS. It has provided design services for the White House site on the World Wide Web, Merrill Lynch and Co Inc and Netscape Communications Corp.
Merrill Lynch is the lead underwriter of the offering, which is expected in late November.
Shares are expected to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol POPT.O.
